notes.title: Devlog for the Expansion to Colonials Programme!
notes.content:
Hello! Just wanted to give you guys an update on the expansion I am working on. And I figured, instead of just another boring old post. I decided to do it as a video instead. This is something that I wanted to do for a long time. So, why not try it out this new expansion to the game.

Check it out on Youtube:
[previewyoutube=PaA4s0k3fd4;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]










In case it wasn't clear in the video, here are some of the additions that are coming to the game.

New Machines:
Shuttle:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39354483/b8b950b3516dbcedd7cc87414c53b41e5c492d5d.png
- A variant of the rocket, consumes fuel to launch. After which, it takes off into space and returns with a stash of Rdin (Cobalt) after a certain amount of time. 

Workshop:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39354483/722ec430700916f9b1a234b70bb6b190206e4328.png
- The workshop creates advanced essentials that are used in the new expansion. It turns Cobalt into Tools and Kriz (Crystals) into Luxuries. (Yes, Kriz will become an element that is used ingame!)

Depot:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39354483/6ec780f1212cbd05475f397afa513fc28064097b.png
- The depot generates an entirely new grid that is, the engineers' grid. It is orange in colour, and uses the gear icon. It works similarly to how a capacitor or silo would. But it can hold up to 3 engineers. You will need to convert your existing colonists into engineers! Machines within the engineers' grid will receive a significant boost to their production. This bonus depends on how many engineers there are in a depot. But watch out, as engineers also consume tools in addition to their normal colonist needs (Food, Water, Oxygen).

That is all for this post! I definitely plan on doing more devlogs like these so be sure look out for them! And as always thank you very much for reading this!

notes.title: Update 1.1.6! UI Animations!
notes.content:
Hello! This is just a particularly quick update to the game. After implementing the Codex update, I've realized that the game's UI was pretty static. So, I got inspired to create some new animations for various UI elements. If you check out the game now, you will see that the building, element and essential panels will do a little flipping animation whenever you toggle between them. Also, the info panels will pop in and out whenever you click on a machine. So hopefully, the game feels a little more lively now!

Sorry about the lack of content, but I just haven't been able to get into the mood of developing recently. I promise that I will try to continue working on the expansion moving ahead! Thank you for supporting the game and stay tuned for the next update!

notes.title: The Codex Update 1.1.5
notes.content:
Hello everybody! It is about that time again, where a new update to Colonials Programme is released! This time, I wanted to make some quality of life improvements to the game.

I've gotten some inspiration for this while I was playing some other games. And I realized that CP could use an upgrade on how the game mechanics are being presented. For example, the tutorial screens are rather wordy and not always clear. Furthermore, it is tucked away in the menu screen, where it is difficult to access. So, I decided to come up with this "Codex" feature for the game.

Check it out:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39354483/04da897e600e92323c1b5ec55a44a6bc02bb4e96.png

In this update, you can now click on the elements, essentials (power, water etc.) Or right click the build machine buttons to bring up the codex entry. The codex details what the thing you clicked is, and how you can utilize it. The various terms used are colour coded according to it's category. (Blue for elements, green for essentials, red for others.) Also, you can click on each of these terms or the icons under the recipes tab, and it'll bring up the codex entry for that.

Colonials Programme is a rather abstract game and it has always been daunting to understand at first. So, I hope this system will make information on the game easily accessible and intuitive. Not just for new players, but for all you veterans of the game too! Oh, and I made some minor improvements to the game's initial tutorial sequences too!

It has been a while since CP was released, and honestly, sometimes I'm amazed at how far the game has come. CP looked and felt very different on launch date, and I am really happy to see the game grow into something much more. Of course, all of this wouldn't be possible without your support! It brings me joy when I see a post or review stating that you guys actually liked the game, and I cannot thank you enough for that! But with that, as I said in my last post, a new expansion is currently in the works. And I am very excited about it! So here's another little sneak-peek of a new machine called the "Refugium"!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39354483/2584a876692a8772063891448f905a373674972c.png

Stay tuned for the next update!

notes.title: Update 1.1.4! Roaming Entities!!
notes.content:
Hello! I have made some small changes and improvements to the game. In this update, there will now be actual colonists and aliens roaming around your colony. That's right! You won't just be watching the number of colonists at the top of your screen go up now. Try to spot them in the screenshot below!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39354483/41cd5d11f04caa992cc366fd0bde98a463829c9b.png

I've always had the models for them, and I've always wanted to add them, so it's awesome to finally see them in the game! I hope to add AI & Mimi soon as well, though I will need to work on their animations.

Besides that, I've added keyboard shortcuts to the various buttons on the screen. There were shortcuts for the power and resource grid, but nobody really knew of them. Now, if you scroll over the buttons, the tool tip will show you the shortcuts. You can toggle between panels using the key 'T', and access buildings using the '1-6' number keys. Oh, and if you wish to rotate machines, you can use the keys 'Q' and 'R' too.

That's all for this update! Stay tuned for the next and thank you for your support!!

notes.title: Update 1.1.3!
notes.content:
Hello! First off, I would like to apologize for being away for about a month now. Honestly, I have been feeling rather burnt out. And life has been pretty busy for me in the past month. So, I decided to take a bit of break and focus on some other things that I enjoy doing.

But now, I'm happy to say that I'm slowly getting back into game development. Over the past few weeks, I have been updating all the UI elements bit by bit to the new style. And today I am finally finished with all UI elements that needed to be updated. I have to say, it was quite a tedious and boring process. But looking at the results, I think that it was definitely worth the effort!

As for what is to come, I am as of yet, not quite sure. The next thing on my to-do list is to improve the store page and trailer for the game. But, I have also started to look into possible ways to translate the game. Gameplay-wise, I still have a few ideas that I want to implement, but they require some refinement still. Overall, I think that CP is a decent position now, but there is always more that can be improved. So if you have any feedback, I would love to hear them. That is all for today. As always, I cannot thank you enough for all your support! Stay tuned for the next update! :)

notes.title: Tutorial Update 1.1.2! New Power and Inda Sequence!!
notes.content:
Hello! It's time for another update to Colonials Programme! This time, I've made more improvements to the tutorial of the game. The previous update to the tutorial was Update 1.0.3, which was a long time ago. And while it did streamline the tutorial, I mentioned that more could be done to improve it still. Again, the beginning of the game is rather rough and difficult to get into, so I hope that this update will improve the experience.

One of the new things I've added, is a new exclamation mark indicator that hovers above a machine, when it lacks a certain resource. Back in the day, when this occurs, it will simply show the box indicator, which is exactly the same as the one used to indicate that the machine is not connected to the resource grid. Understandably, this could be confusing to new players. So, I decided to create this new indicator to clear up any misconceptions.

This generator is connected to the resource grid, but it is missing Ikat!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39354483/6cde00382f9477867e45d3e68b1a2c1c49384739.png

Next, I've also added two new tutorial sequences, akin to the one teaching the basics of grid management. These two new sequences will ensure that new players have a basic understanding of the two most important resources; Power and Inda. When I implemented the grid tutorial sequence, I really liked the concept of it. It teaches you how to expand each grid accordingly, then it tests your understanding of it. I think that this is a great way to explain the complicated mechanics of CP, so I tried my best to mimic it with these new sequences. I don't think it's as clean as the grid sequence, but hopefully, it'll still be a more engaging and fun experience for new players.

Fix the Power Shortage!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39354483/a139fda726ed43e883a06e498f88a84601ce28cf.png

Also, all the tutorial pop-ups that occur during the game itself have been updated to the style of the new UI design. It's nice that, they do not stick out like a sore thumb any longer. Of course, I still have plans to update the UI of the Main Menu, Campaign Menu and Map Editor, so you expect those soon! The summarized tutorials were also hopelessly outdated, so I decided to update those as well.

The tutorial screens are looking a lot nicer now!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39354483/333d999b286fa95348e31cfbaecbe853857389b3.png

That's it for this week! If you haven't gotten the game already, there's still a discount following Steam's Lunar New Year Sale, so be sure to check it out! Thank you once again for your support! :)

notes.title: Update 1.1.1! Alternative names for the Elements
notes.content:
Hello! This is just a quick patch to the game which adds alternate names to the elements' tooltips. Hopefully, it'll make things a little easier for those unfamiliar with the game to understand them.

I understand that a lot of people find the names of the elements weird and confusing! And I just wanted to clarify my intentions and explain where they came from. 

So, the names of the elements are just snippets that I took from words in a language called Basque. If there are any Basques reading this, I'm really sorry for this! The elements were the very first thing that I came up with after conceptualizing Colonials Programme. I wanted the elements to sound strange and exotic. CP was initially an exploration game of sorts. Where you will harvest elements from the world, then combine them to form strange compounds with different properties. I was really into organic chemistry at that time, and that's where the concept of the game arose. This was the first table of elements I designed: (Yes, my handwriting is terrible)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39354483/abd787e96cee907711501f4c6e6f78d10630bc23.png

Of course, it eventually morphed into a building game, and the whole combining elements thing took a back seat to this all. But, each element did have an English name and represent an aspect of something. They still do! 'Ikat' is coal, 'Hez' is moisture, and 'Lioa' is oil. There are also some weird ones; 'Inda' was meant to represent 'Strong', and 'Horm' represents 'Wall'. I opted to rename these two, Iron and Steel respectively for simplicity sake. So hopefully, this will make things a little easier for everyone!

EDIT: I'm working on two new sequences, akin to the current one teaching the grid mechanics. These will teach the fundamentals about generating power, Inda and maintenance costs. You can expect the update very soon!

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE 1.1.0! Visual Overhaul of Colonials Programme out now!!
notes.content:
DISCLAIMER: If you haven't bought the game yet, I advise you to wait until 1st February 10AM PST, when the game will be discounted!!

Hello, once again it's CookieLegends, and I'm very happy and excited to announce the new major update to Colonials Programme!

It's been a month since Colonials Programme has been released, and I have to say that I am very happy about the reception I've gotten so far! It's really been an incredible journey and a life-changing experience for me personally. And I don't think I would have gotten here if it were not for you guys! Seriously, I'm always happy to receive comments, feedback and suggestions from the community and I can't thank you enough for that!

With that said, I believe that it's my turn to give back to all the supporters of the game by releasing the first major update which I have been teasing for a while now! The new In-Game UI is now fully functional and I'm very happy about the results:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39354483/da9ba3355fb40e2fc06330de658f596d76364268.png

I think that the game looks a lot better now, and I have to say that I'm very proud of it! It almost feels like a completely new game to me!

If you paid attention to the screenshot above, you'll see that there are several other improvements made to the game, besides the UI itself. On the bottom-right corner, there's a new panel which shows the machine or terrain you're currently hovering over. I've gotten feedback in the past, that it was difficult for beginners to differentiate the machines and terrain features on the map. So, I think that this is a neat little solution to the problem!

Furthermore, the map itself looks quite different now! I've applied a new toon-shader for the game, and updated the tiles of the map to make them more visually appealing. I hope that you will enjoy the new style of the game as much as I do! 

To be honest, the original UI was always meant to be a placeholder while I was developing the game. But during the development phase, I never managed to update it, so it was always rather lacking in my eyes. But, now that the game is released, I've decided to go ahead and update it since I always wanted to do so  from the start.  In a way, I'm thankful that I put it off, since my artistic skills has improved dramatically, compared to when I was still developing the game.

Of course, there's still a lot more to do; the map editor, main menu, tutorial screens and campaign menu has not been updated. I considered delaying the update to work on these elements as well, but I wanted to quickly release the game, as I have been teasing the update for a while now. Rest assured, that they will be updated to the new UI style in upcoming updates. I hope that you can continue being patient with me!

So now what? Well I wanted to share some of the new ideas and plans I have for Colonials Programme, but this post has gotten quite long by now, so I'll save it for the future! Oh, and just a heads up, if you haven't gotten the game yet, the game will be discounted on 1st February 10AM PST via Steam's Weeklong Deals! So be sure to wait out for it!

Once again, I would like to thank everyone for the support! Stay tuned for future updates, as Colonials Programme will continue being updated for the foreseeable future! Thank you!! :)

notes.title: Tutorial Update 1.0.3!
notes.content:
Hello again! It's once again time for another update to Colonials Programme! This time I have updated the tutorial to the game. It's something that I have been meaning to do, after watching many videos on my game. 

I realized that there a lot more ways to make the game more friendly to beginners. A lot of players were getting confused with what to do. So, I wanted to streamline the tutorial. This is important, as I believe that the game is better and more complex once you get deeper into it. Hopefully, this change will aid new players with understanding the game. I'd like to also say that the tutorial is by no means perfect yet, and I will continue to improve it as I get more feedback on it.

Check it out! There's a whole new sequence, teaching the basics of grid management.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39354483/fdc476aa9573a12ee1f8ef34b84228427cc7f92c.png

You can also see some of the new UI elements within the current build of the game. Again, I'm still in the process of developing the new UI Overhaul update. So, I'm trying to transition into it, by using these new UI elements in the new tutorial sequence. When the overhaul comes along, it is likely that this sequence wil be updated with the new in-game UI as well. So stay tuned for it!

That's it for this week! So far I've been able to keep up with my own schedule of one new update per week. I can't promise that this will continue, as real life is getting busier for me. But I can promise that I will certainly try my best to deliver new updates on a regular basis! Either way, you can definitely look forward to the UI Overhaul which will be coming either in late January or early February! Thanks again!

notes.title: Update 1.0.2! New Challenges Added!
notes.content:
Hello! It is time for another quick update! This time I have added 7 new challenge maps which you'll be able to play! Each challenge is accompanied with it's own achievement, so be sure to try to complete them all! I hope this serves as a little thank you, to those who have purchased the game thus far. I really appreciate your support! Fret not, I will continue to add new content and improvements to the game for the foreseeable future.

On another note, if you have already purchased the game, feel free to leave an honest review on the game! I'm always looking for feedback to improve Colonials Programme. Or if you have any suggestions, you can always post them on the game's community hub. I would love to interact with you guys there!

Aside from the challenge maps being added, there have been minor additions and fixes to the game in this update. I have received feedback from players who wished to be able to view the quantity of their elements or essentials. Originally, I did not want to show these numbers, as I thought that it would be an added challenge. However, after watching people play my game, I decided to add tool-tips that show the quantity of elements/essentials. I think that this will make the game more accessible to new players.

I have also received feedback on the inability to view the names of the resource nodes on the map. It can be difficult for new players to identify which nodes contain which elements. I have decided to put this off for now, as I wish to integrate this feature into the planned UI Overhaul update. But for now, a tip I can give is to pay attention to the colour of the resource nodes on the map. They match the colours of the elements, so that's a quick way to tell one from the other. Other than that, please stay tuned for the upcoming UI Overhaul update!

That's it for this update. As always, I hope that you will continue to enjoy my game! Thank you!

notes.title: Update 1.0.1! Special map and skin available!
notes.content:
Hello everybody, this is CookieLegends! I'm back from my little break from the game and I'm happy to be working on the game once again!

A new build has been uploaded as a relatively small update to the game. I've just started my own mailing list such that you guys can keep in touch with the game's development! To accompany it, I'm giving away the soundtrack to Colonials Programme to those who would like to sign up for my mailing list. 

If you own the game already, you can also gain access to a special map that was added to the game, as well as, the TX AICore skin!

Also, to update you on my future plans, I will be working on a UI overhaul amidst feedback that it can be improved. If you didn't know already, you can also follow my blog on the Colonials Programme website.
You can check it out here!

I've shared some of my plans for the future, along with a sneak-peak of the new updated element sprites!  You can head on there for more information if you'd like.

notes.title: Colonials Programme is now out!!
notes.content:
Hi guys! I'm very happy to say that my first game is now officially released!! It's honestly been a dream come true and I hope you guys will enjoy my game as much as I did, while I was working on it.

I just wanted to say thank you to all the followers, and those of you who put my game up on your wishlist. I really appreciate all the support!

Going forward, I have plans to continue updating Colonials Programme, as well adding new content to the game. I'll probably talk about my plans in a separate thread, but for now I'll be taking a short break, so stay tuned!

If you have any questions or concerns, feel free to raise them up using the Steam community hub. I'll be there to help out!

Thanks a bunch! ;)
- CookieLegends
